decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed single storey rear extension, by reason of excessive depth would be harmful to the appearance of the dwelling and would not preserve or enhance the Wellesley Road Conservation Area. The depth of the extension is significantly beyond the building line at other properties and is not characteristic of the area. The proposal is contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed single storey rear extension and new boundary wall, by reason of excessive depth and height would be harmful to the open outlook from neighbouring properties on either side. The proposal would adversely impact on the amenity of the properties at either side, and is therefore contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - 3.	The proposed single storey rear extension would result in insufficient outdoor amenity space for the ground floor flat, in an area that is identified as being deficient in public open space. This would be harmful to the amenity of future occupiers and is contrary to the Supplementary Planning Guidance 1997 and Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the flat and erection of new boundary wall
